pr.title: Rename the band to the panel
pr.head: eb06fe31481293ecb65b5872a674f838b7565ee4

summary: In Claude Code, the Projector plugin draws a list above the prompt: the pull requests your review and watch loops track, and your inbox of questions and notices that agents post with the ask and tell tools. Until now everything called that list the band. The pull request beneath this one, #336, draws it as one panel on a background of its own, and the owner asked for the feature to be called the panel everywhere, so no reader wonders whether the band and the panel are two things.

This pull request is that rename and nothing else. It changes what people read (the docs, the README, two loop skills), what agents read (the /projector command's description, the inbox tools' descriptions and results, and the agent instructions' template), and the hooks module's code: identifiers, comments, test names, the test file's name, and the keys under which the module stores its state in the Claude Code session. Claude Code's own terms, such as the AbovePrompt site, keep their names, and the earlier sections of the inbox and questions plans keep "band" as their history.

One part of the rename is not cosmetic. The hooks module keeps its state in the session, which outlives a reload or an update of the plugin, and the module now reads that state under new key names. A session that updates therefore starts with empty state. The pull request accepts that the panel starts hidden after the update. The review found that the empty state also loses the record of an answer the panel was still delivering, so that answer reaches the agent twice; the flag on hooks/register.tsx explains how.

cards.title: Terms on this page
cards.html:
• Panel (formerly the band): the plugin's list above the prompt, of loop pull requests and inbox items.
  • Session state: values the hooks module stores in the Claude Code session through atom, by plugin and key. They survive a reload or an update of the module.
  • Claim: a lease of 60 seconds that project inbox claim gives one deliverer of an answered question, renewed while the delivery waits, so two deliverers never send the same answer.
  • Begin marker: the <!-- projector:begin N --> line that versions the generated block of agent instructions.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:

groups.title: The hooks module
groups.kicker: The code that draws the panel, renamed, including the session-state keys it stores
intro: The hooks module, under hooks/, is the TypeScript the Claude Code plugin runs: it draws the panel, registers the inbox tools, and delivers the answers you pick to the agent that asked. Its identifiers, comments, and the strings it shows say "panel" now. The local isPanel, which was true when the surface is a terminal, becomes isTerminal, since every surface now draws the panel.

The module stores nine values in the session through atom, and eight of their keys change, such as bandSending to panelSending; seenLoops keeps its name. hooks/types.d.ts declares the keys, and the typecheck fails when the declaration and the atoms disagree. Nothing reads the old keys, so after an update each of them starts from its default.

checks.text: Compared the old and new lines of every hooks file with "band" replaced by "panel": the only other changes are the isPanel rename, the reworded comments where "the panel draws as one panel" would repeat itself, and the test constant ENGINE_PANEL, now ENGINE_SITE.

files.note: The panel's hooks: state keys, comments, the strings the tools return, and isPanel renamed to isTerminal.

checks.text: Updating mid-delivery sends a queued answer to the agent twice. When you answer while the agent is busy, the panel submits the answer as a prompt that waits behind the running turn, and records that delivery under this key so a reloaded module keeps renewing the claim. The previous release recorded it under bandSending, which nothing reads now. After an update, the old claim lapses in 60 seconds and the panel claims and submits the answer again. A copy of the existing test for this case, seeded under bandSending, shows the second submit. The fix is to move the old entries into panelSending on load, or to keep the stored key's name.
isTerminal is the old isPanel: whether the surface is a terminal, which decides the inset, padding, background, header, and drawer rule.

groups.title: Agent instructions and the Python side
groups.kicker: The generated instructions block moves to version 13, and Python comments follow
intro: project init writes a block of instructions into a repository's AGENTS.md from src/projector/templates/agents-block.md. Its begin marker carries a version, and tests/test_instructions.py pins each version's text by hash, so a change to the text must raise the version. One line of that text named the band, so the block moves to version 13, and this repository's own AGENTS.md is refreshed with it.
In src/projector, only comments and docstrings change.
